template_notice: Illustrates authoring fields only. Example entities, frames and predicates require actual definitions and bindings. No paper claim, qualified motion or executable controller is supplied.
preconditions: The identified specimen is held in the verified grasp
The compatible holder is empty, open and available
Holder pose, tool limits, contact surfaces and access path are supplied
The required station and fixture resources are reserved

substeps.action: Locate holder seating surfaces and inspect for obstruction
substeps.completion_observation: Holder identity, open state and accessible seating region confirmed

substeps.action: Approach the supplied loading frame while supporting the held specimen
substeps.completion_observation: Tool/specimen pose reaches the pre-insertion region with required clearance

substeps.action: Align the specimen with the holder's locating features using observed pose
substeps.completion_observation: Alignment meets the declared input condition

substeps.action: Place the specimen onto the supplied support/locating surfaces
substeps.completion_observation: Supported seated state confirmed before release

substeps.action: Release the grasp after support is established and retract
substeps.completion_observation: Gripper clear and empty; specimen remains supported

substeps.action: Inspect specimen identity, seating and orientation
substeps.completion_observation: Seating accepted or a retained failed-attempt state is reported

device_process_and_wait: No device process is implied by placing the specimen

observation_conditioned_decisions.when: Holder identity, compatibility or access inspection fails
observation_conditioned_decisions.choose: Stop this placement and return to supported fixture inspection/reselection
Retain the grasp and request a new observed alignment or a declared recovery
Release and inspect; otherwise do not advance to clamping or acquisition

provenance.basis_and_rationale: A specimen must be located and supported before a grasp can be released into a holder
provenance.selected_assumption: A compatible open holder with locating/support surfaces is provided
alternatives: Place a retained specimen carrier using a separately defined carrier/holder interface
provenance.confidence_and_validation: Illustrative design logic only; actual geometry and the supported placement need review and testing

postconditions: The same specimen instance occupies the holder and retains its lineage
The gripper is empty and retracted
The specimen is supported and seating passes the declared acceptance condition
Clamping and acquisition still require their own operations

attempt_outcome_contract.success: Every success postcondition is established by current evidence for this specimen and attempt
attempt_outcome_contract.failure: Retain the observed failure state and block dependent success transitions
attempt_outcome_contract.unknown: Missing or conflicting observations cannot establish success; obtain observations or enter a declared stop/recovery path

completion_evidence: Observed seating/identity state linked to the actual specimen and attempt
Trusted state-transition record if an execution backend is implemented

failure_and_recovery.response: Keep the specimen supported, retain the failed attempt and return to fixture inspection/reselection

failure_and_recovery.observation: Alignment or support cannot be confirmed
failure_and_recovery.response: Do not release; retain the current state and use a separately defined supported recovery before any bounded retry
Block clamping/acquisition and enter a declared recovery or abort path
